subject: general
question: If in a code language, 'EAR' is coded as JFW, and 'CUP' is coded as HZU, then what will 'LIGHT' be coded as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is: 

For EAR - JFW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3078e749ce0b6e031986fef6b669e72c452e2e23fc957230b42b294b1b660ad.png] 

For CUP - HZW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/686203e78e427428966e44c4e73900eb1f5abe195da10a18ac47966eb8a52cc0.png] 

Similarly for LIGHT - QNLMY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8aec76a0479a6b7e3ceb02c7e3b415a3702b9db59e4fbfcf11c4ec4642b66eff.png] 

So**, LIGHT will be coded as QNLMY**

Hence the correct answer is,** "Option 3".**
